steps.text: 这是时间轴。结果在开打那一瞬就定了，这里只是回放：朝上的刻度是我方打出的，朝下的是挨的，长刻度是有人倒下。拖它可以来回看。

texts.en: This is the timeline. The outcome was decided the moment the fight began; this is just the replay. Ticks pointing up are hits you dealt, ticks pointing down are hits you took, and a long tick means someone fell. Drag it to scrub back and forth.

steps.text: 播放、倍速、跳过：播完再按是重播，倍速一二四倍循环，跳过直接看结尾，结果都不会变。

texts.en: Play, Speed, Skip. Press play after it ends to replay; Speed cycles through normal, double and quadruple; Skip jumps to the end. None of it changes the result.

steps.text: 这一排是上身的增益和减益，鼠标停在图标上看效果。

texts.en: This row shows the buffs and debuffs on you. Hover over an icon to see what it does.

steps.text: 看完这里会出现「继续」，按它接着赶路。

texts.en: When the replay ends, Continue appears here. Press it to move on.
